payload.title: The no-orphan-memory invariant covers 3 of the 58 memory=True surfaces by opt-in, and no test requires a new memory surface to declare a LEARNED_KINDS entry or a named exemption, so a new learned kind lands ungated while the doctor provenance organ still reads ok
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/row_provenance.py:11-13 (the module names the memory flag as the one declaration of what ARIA learned)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/row_provenance.py:62-66 (LEARNED_KINDS declares three kinds: belief, convention, episode)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/state_manifest.py:939-952 (memory_surfaces() is the whole self-learning record; 58 surfaces carry memory=True)
aria-kernel/tests/test_row_provenance.py:150-164 (tests pin the exact three kinds and that each is a memory surface; nothing requires the other direction)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/ownership_atlas.py:262-267 (provenance_offenders iterates LEARNED_KINDS only, so an undeclared memory surface is never an offender)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/doctor.py:732-734 (the provenance organ reads ok whenever the declared kinds hold no orphan)
payload.rule_violated: F0.9p / PLAN-v2 no-orphan invariant (row_provenance.py module docstring: every memory kind a later package adds needs a gate that says its row names a source); CLAUDE.md tier 3, the wrong behaviour must be detectable at build time.
payload.notes: F4.1 (lessons), F4.4 or F4.5 (uncertainties) adds a memory=True surface whose rows cite nothing. provenance_offenders and every test stay green, because only the surfaces named in LEARNED_KINDS are read, and the doctor provenance organ reports ok from a census of three kinds. The module's statement that the memory flag is the one declaration of what ARIA learned is then false for the new kind, and nothing detects it. Close condition: Add a test over state_manifest.memory_surfaces() minus the LEARNED_KINDS surfaces that is green only when every remaining surface is in a closed exemption table with a one-line reason; adding a memory=True surface without a Learned entry or an exemption then fails the build. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
